notes: NVLink calibration/characterization is NVIDIA-internal and PHY-specific (closed-loop adaptive CTLE/DFE, CDR, TX equalization; PAM4 slicer thresholds at Gen4). Per-flit CRC + replay counters serve as the in-system signal-integrity health metric. Public visibility is via NVML / nvidia-smi nvlink telemetry and the NVSwitch fabric manager.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: NVHS eye diagram per lane
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify TX output + RX input meet the NVHS eye masks after equalization; NRZ (Gen1-3) two-level eye, PAM4 (Gen4) three stacked eyes.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PAM4 eye / margin (Gen4)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the four-level eye stays open at the Gen4 line rate; per-lane margin telemetry.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Per-link bandwidth
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure achieved 50 GB/s bidirectional per link (Gen2-4) / 40 GB/s (Gen1); aggregate to 160/300/600/900 GB/s for P100/V100/A100/H100.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: CRC / replay rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure flit CRC-error and replay rates as a signal-integrity health metric.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Lane de-skew / alignment
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the 8 lane pairs of a sub-link de-skew and align within budget.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: NVSwitch fabric throughput
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate all-to-all bandwidth across an NVSwitch fabric (DGX/HGX).
